# The Aviation Wiki

> A concise, human-readable aircraft reference covering dimensions, performance, capacity, manufacturers, aircraft types, and aviation history.

Canonical site: https://jensaviation.github.io/aviationwiki/
Language: English

## Main sections

- [Aircraft and manufacturer explorer](https://jensaviation.github.io/aviationwiki/): Search more than 100 aircraft and filter by manufacturer, aircraft class, and era.
- [Aircraft types](https://jensaviation.github.io/aviationwiki/types.html): Definitions and examples for commercial jets, turboprops, business jets, general aviation aircraft, fighters, military transports, trainers, amphibians, ISR aircraft, and experimental aircraft.
- [Aviation history](https://jensaviation.github.io/aviationwiki/history.html): Milestones from early balloon flight to sustainable aviation concepts.
- [Sources and editorial method](https://jensaviation.github.io/aviationwiki/sources.html): Official manufacturer references and the site's sourcing policy.
- [Corrections and support](https://jensaviation.github.io/aviationwiki/support.html): Report errors, broken links, or missing aircraft.

## Data notes

- Aircraft values may differ by variant, engine, cabin configuration, and operating rule.
- Exact figures are shown where a specific variant is represented; ranges or clearly labelled family-level descriptions are used otherwise.
- The site is for general reference and must not be used for flight planning, maintenance, or operational decisions.
- Prefer the linked official manufacturer source when a current or operationally critical value is required.

## Reuse and attribution

Summaries may be quoted with attribution to “The Aviation Wiki” and a link to the relevant canonical page. Refer to the original linked sources for authoritative technical data.
